name: com.reromanlee.reactivelocalizer
description: Localization for any project size, from a five-minute prototype to hundreds of thousands of entries. Text tables live as mergeable files per language, keys are checked at compile time, ICU plurals and arguments get typed generated methods, and reactive bindings follow language switches without any per-frame work. A pure C# core with no dependencies runs on every platform, WebGL included, with a table editor, validation, and spreadsheet, XLIFF and LLM exchange in the Editor.

samples.description: Everything a prototype needs: GlobalLocalizer, a project-wide access point that remembers the player's language and maps the OS language; a language picker; the base of the UI samples' components; and a scene whose texts follow every switch, in English, Russian and an invented Pirate language that falls back to English.

A component that shows an entry in a TextMeshPro text through every language switch without creating strings, a font per language with a check of which characters each font can't draw, and a Localize action in the text's context menu that turns its current text into a new entry. Import Quick Start first.

Entries in UI Toolkit text: a data binding declared in UXML or UI Builder on Unity 6, a BindText call from code on every version, and a component that localizes a UIDocument's elements by name with no code. Import Quick Start first.
A component that shows an entry in a legacy uGUI Text, with a Localize action in its context menu. Import Quick Start first.

Tables marked @delivery Custom load through Addressables, at addresses a menu sets up, so they download and update with the rest of the content; a table Addressables don't have falls back as usual. Requires Addressables; import Quick Start first.

An installer that registers a catalog's localizer with VContainer, initializes it asynchronously as the container starts, and hands it to Quick Start's access point. Requires VContainer; import Quick Start first.
R3 observables of localized text, of messages fed by other observables, and of the current language, each one a binding released with its subscription. Requires R3.

Two-way sync of a catalog with a private Google spreadsheet, one sheet per table, through an Apps Script that answers only a secret token and never publishes the sheet; pulls go through the import preview. Its README sets it up.

Fan translations read from a mods folder in the player's data: they patch shipped languages entry by entry and add new languages at runtime. Comes with an example mod to install. Import Quick Start first.
An editor window localized with a catalog of its own inside an Editor folder, as package and tool authors ship it: its texts never mix with the game's and never reach a build.

Converts the project's Unity Localization locales and string table collections into a Localization catalog and .lang files, keys, comments and plain placeholders included, and lists what needs converting by hand. Requires Unity Localization.
